title: Dynamic IDs on the Board
description: Row ids on the scheduling board reshuffle under Practice mode's "Dynamic ids" toggle, same trick as the login form — except here it's applied to a live drag-and-drop surface, which is a much less forgiving place for a brittle locator to fail.
successCondition: With Practice mode's "Dynamic ids" toggle switched on, a test drags a shipment card (located by its visible content — shipment id text or origin/destination labels — not a hardcoded data-testid) from Unassigned onto a vehicle column, and the same script re-run after toggling the setting off and back on (which reshuffles the salt) still succeeds identically both times.
hints: The toggle lives under "Locators" in the Practice mode drawer, bottom-right of every page.

FleetBoard's row ids follow the pattern fleet-row-<shipmentId>-<salt> when the toggle is on — locate by the shipment's rendered content instead, since the salt changes every time the toggle is re-enabled.
